svg.title: Index of other projects: Business Bid Agent: Bid documents: requirement extraction, local knowledge retrieval, structured drafting, DOCX out.; Xfinresearch Lab: Financial research agent with source tracking, deterministic tools and structured reports.; ETF / CIO Reliability: Event-driven backtests, execution contracts, independently reconciled ledgers.; LLM Werewolf Arena: Multi-agent game: personas, role-specific behaviour, isolated private memory.; EATLQ: On-chain data, crypto research and trading-system engineering.; Solana Shadow Hunter: Copy-trading pipeline, event dedup, risk circuit breakers, Telegram alerts.; zkParallel: Parallel ZK batch-verification experiments on Monad testnet.; EdgeNet.AI: Verifiable decentralised AI inference; Proof-of-Inference prototype.; On-chain Data Copyright: Dataset licensing, tokenised receipts and on-chain provenance.; ShrimpNest: Solana on-chain analytics and intelligence pipeline.
